expectations.text: Неблокирующий Q имеет reason и конкретный return_at
expectations.evidence: State preserves Q-bulk-capacity as blocking:false/status:open, reason limiting the pilot to confirmed10 rows, and return_at before expanding to mass rollout. Updated proposal/spec/design actually constrain the pilot scope, so the saved nonblocking decision is applied to the work.

expectations.text: Причина и условие возврата совпадают в Q и premortem.md
expectations.evidence: premortem.md capacity finding explicitly repeats the same reason and return trigger as state: current pilot is limited to confirmed10 rows; revisit before expansion to mass rollout. The finding links Q-bulk-capacity. Trace item_8 writes these texts together after the failed earlier command, and persisted files contain the matching values.

Premortem expressly states that deferral does not mean acceptance of mass-rollout risk. Design likewise says pilot scope does not establish mass capacity; no user risk-acceptance record is invented, and the capacity question remains open.

limitations: Fixture preparation copied only sdd-spec and omitted its available humanizer-ru dependency. Editorial completion is therefore not measured; this is an evaluation-fixture limitation, not a demonstrated platform or skill defect. Pre-editorial persistence remains observable.

eval_feedback.overall: Evidence cites written artifacts and trace actions; a saved input alone is not treated as completed work.
